description: Increases 2024 elementary school land levy for 10-acre sites.
Reduces 2025 high school land levy to $89.30 per meter.
Mayor to request meeting on school land funding with province.

chips.text: Recommended to Council
6 for, 0 against
Mayor Block requested a report on school land funding in other provinces.
Kensington and Aswin Ridge neighborhoods are exempt from the 10-acre elementary levy.
Whether Ontario's education development charges are property tax funded remained unclear.
Developers expressed concerns regarding affordability of school land levies.
Administration will provide a verbal update on other provinces' funding next week.
